notes:
New
• Competition Intro cuts now match the creator's own edit: every take is transcribed on its own, so false starts are removed, and every pause between lines is cut
• Your real Zoom Out (from 200%) preset on the hook: a Transform effect with motion blur, not a custom zoom
• Captions placed on the timeline as editable text, popping in like Quick Bounce (falls back to a captions file if Premiere can't place them)
• Labels on the timeline wherever you need to add something: "b-roll here", "image here", "pop up …" and "transition here" (Competition Intro and Long Form); drop your own image or clip in
• Sounds learned from your editing: a slide on the hook zoom, a hit leading each big zoom, a pop for pop-ups, risers into b-roll and the cliffhanger, a comedic hit on the payoff

Fixed
• Music was silent or too broken up: Competition Intros now get one continuous music bed, and Solis checks the level Premiere really set
• No more random bass drops
• Pauses were kept whenever your face moved; they're cut now
• Solis no longer picks or searches for images; it marks the spot and you drop the image in

Testing
• Captions and the Zoom Out preset are new in Premiere; tell us with Send Feedback if they don't appear
• Transitions (Premiere Composer Pan, Shake & Distort) are not added yet
